1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One low blade with two local material displacements and one disposable voxel.

2.label: easy
2.summary: A wider blade requires routing material through neighboring occupied columns.

3.label: medium
3.summary: A raised socket and thin cutting edge require choosing between flattening and raising material; two excess voxels may be split.

4.label: hard
4.summary: More deeply redistributed relief requires temporarily moving useful metal; only one voxel may be discarded.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: A deeper socket and four possible heights couple routing to vertical headroom; no disposable metal remains.

simplified.summary: Choose hammer mode and direction, click an exposed top face, and use transfer/orbit buttons.

full.summary: Choose the same mode and direction, drag the hammer onto an exposed top face, drag the tongs between anvil and forge, and drag the orbit rail.
